items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Published by Carl Fisher. Yeah, yeah, that's right.

ctx.x: Ben Verricon, yeah. I think they still got those books, yeah.
Ben Verricon. Published by Carl Fisher. Yeah, yeah, that's right. When you started on trombone, you remember the book that your uncle gave you or anything?
Yeah, I can't think of the name. Now, let's see. His name is a book now. I'll give this boy one. He's good. A trumpet? Yeah. I can't think of that mouthpiece. That book.
